docs.text: Originally created by: BillyBob1304, Bittorn, fizzdeff, Alowaski Created and maintained by the Shaymin League Council It is your responsibility to stay up-to-date with our rules. If you find navigating this document difficult, use the Find shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd + F) to search for keywords! Update Notice! Updated from our previous custom format to the National Dex OU format by Smogon Two gimmicks can be used (e.g. Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Terastalization), however if a player is using Dynamax/Gigantamax they may only use that gimmick. Adjusted some minor rules. Adjusted some of the banned Pokémon, Z-Moves, Legendaries, Mythicals and Ubermons. Changelog General Challengers must acquire 8 badges before challenging Elite Trainers. There are no banned moves … 🙂 …but there are banned Z-Moves 🙁 Champions Champions may not have any custom rules in their battles . If a challenger loses against the Champion, they must re-challenge 2 randomly selected Elite Trainers . If a Champion doesn't accept any challengers for more than 5 days they will be stripped of their title . The next Challenger to then beat the required Elite Trainers will be the next Champion . Rules for Challengers When challenging a Gym, players are limited to no more than one Limited Pokémon on their team. Challengers may only use up to 2 gimmicks (Mega Evolution, Z-Moves or Terastalization) or only use 1 if the gimmick is Dynamax/Gigantamax. When challenging Elite Trainers or the Champion players are limited to no more than one Limited Pokémon/slot on their team Challengers must have collected 8 gym badges before challenging elite trainers. Challengers must have collected 4 elite badges before challenging the champion. External consumable items (ex. Potion, Revive, X Attack, etc.) may not be used. Rules for Gyms & Gym Leaders All gyms must be themed, though theming is not limited to mono-type teams. Set to Level 50 (to keep battles fair for both sides). May be any battle type (single, double, triple, team). Gyms do not have to be beaten in any particular order. Held items are allowed but external items (ex. Potion, Revive, X Attack, etc.) may not be used. Gym Leaders are restricted to having up to one Limited Pokémon. Gym Leaders may set whatever additional rules they wish (within reason) (ex. the challenger must have at least one flying type on their team). Gym Leaders may collect Gym Badges and Elite Badges while still being a Gym Leader. Gym Leaders may also simultaneously be Elite Trainers so long as they use different teams. Gym Leaders may also simultaneously be the Champion so long as they use different teams. Players may have more than one gym so long as they use different teams and themes for each gym. A gym’s classification as either Standard or Advanced will be determined via its gym leader battling a League Council member’s approved vetting team (a team potentially different from their regular team, roughly built to simulate a higher tier player’s team) to give the League Council a demonstration of how strong the gym’s team and leader are. All gyms that opt in to the Cobblemon League must display the designated given item of verification from the League Council on the front of or in their gym so as to clearly let players know if said gym is a verified gym part of the Cobblemon League and that its badge counts toward Elite Trainer entry. Rules for Elite Trainers Elite Trainers are the effective replacement of the games Elite 4 as we will be having more than 4 players admitted to this role. All Elite Trainer teams must be themed, though theming is not limited to single-type teams. Level 50 only (to keep battles fair for both sides). May be any battle type (single, double, triple, team). Elite Trainers do not have to be beaten in any particular order. Elite Trainer team sizes must have a minimum of 5 Pokémon and have no cap. Held items are allowed, and duplicate items are limited to no more than two per team, but external items (ex. Potion, Revive, X Attack, etc.) may not be used. Elite Trainers are restricted to having up to one Limited Pokémon. Gym leaders may only use up to 2 gimmicks (mega evolution, z-moves or Terastalization ) or only use 1 if the gimmick is dmax/gmax. Elite Trainers may also simultaneously be Gym Leaders so long as they use different teams. To gain entry to the Elite Trainers a player must collect at least 10 Gym Badges (this number will likely increase as more gyms are built as the server goes on [should this requirement increase, Elite Trainer and the Champion will not be required to meet this new requirement to retain their position]). Elite Trainers must have been a Gym Leader prior to becoming an Elite Trainer. Elite Trainers are chosen by the Shyamin Council from among the active Gym Leaders. Gym leaders' knowledge are factored into this process. Should an existing Elite Trainer start to underperform as a member of the Elite Trainers then they can be replaced at the League Council’s discretion (this does not prevent them from potentially re-earning their position as an Elite Trainer). Should an Elite Trainer not accept any valid challenges for longer than a period of 5 days without notice their title can be removed and given to another valid player at the League Council’s discretion (this does not prevent them from potentially re-earning their position as an Elite Trainer). Elite Trainers will give out badges and will be referred to as Elite Badges. After a challenger has lost to an elite trainer a cooldown of 15 minutes must pass before they are able to rechallenge the elite member. They may challenge other elite members during this time. Rules for Champions Can only be a singles battle. The Champion is restricted to having up to one Limited Pokémon. The Champion may only use up to 2 gimmicks (mega evolution, z-moves or Terastalization) or only use 1 if the gimmick is dmax/gmax. The Champion can not set any custom rules for their battles. Held items are allowed, and duplicate items are limited to no more than two per team, but external items (ex. Potion, Revive, X Attack, etc.) may not be used. The Champion may also simultaneously be Gym Leaders so long as they use different teams. The Champion may not simultaneously be an Elite Trainer. To gain entry to the Champion a player must collect all 4 Elite Badges (should an Elite Trainer whom they won a badge from be swapped out before said player gains entry to the Champion they will not have to earn the badge of the new Elite Trainer). If a challenger loses their battle with the Champion, they must re-challenge 2 elite trainers before re-challenging the champion. These two Elite Trainers will be selected at random by a council member. Should a player lose their Champion title, they must first earn 2 more Elite Badges (on top of the badges they earned before) to re-earn their Champion title. Should the Champion not accept any valid challenges for longer than a period of 5 days without notice their title can be removed and the position of Champion will become vacant. The next challenger to beat the Elite Trainers becomes the champion. The team used to challenge the Champion will become the new Champion’s team. There are no theme restrictions. A maximum of one limited slot. Pokémon's moves may be changed at any time. Z-Moves and Terastalization While you may use Z-Moves and/or Terastalization in battles, each instance will take up one of your Limited slots. Banned Pokémon If a Pokémon is not listed, then it is not banned. Legendaries Mewtwo Lugia Ho-Oh Kyogre Groudon Rayquaza Dialga (Both forms) Palkia (Both forms) Giratina (Both forms) Reshiram Zekrom Kyurem (White & Black forms) Xerneas Yveltal Zygarde (50% & 100%) Solgaleo Lunala Necrozma - Dusk Mane Necrozma - Dawn Wings Zacian (Both forms) Zamazenta (Crowned) Eternatus Calyrex (Ice & Shadow Rider) Koraidon Miraidon Terapagos Spectrier Chi-Yu Pheromosa Urshifu (Single-strike) Ogerpon (Hearthflame) Naganadel Landorus-Incarnate Mythicals Arceus (All forms) Deoxys (Attack, Balance & Speed forms) Darkrai Shaymin (Sky form) Genesect Magearna Marshadow Mega Pokémon Mega Gengar Mega Kangaskhan Mega Mewtwo X Mega Mewtwo Y Mega Salamence Mega Metagross Mega Rayquaza Primal Kyogre Primal Groudon Mega Blaziken Mega Blastoise Mega Alakazam Mega Lucario Paradox Pokémon Flutter Mane Iron Bundle Roaring Moon Walking Wake Banned Z-Moves If a Z-Move is not listed, then it is not banned. Extreme Evoboost Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike Light That Burns the Sky Searing Sunraze Smash Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom Clangorous Soulblaze Restricted Uber Pokémon You may only have one restricted Ubermon on your team. If an Ubermon is not listed, then it is banned. Annihilape Baxcaliber Darmanitan-Galar Dracovish Dragapult Espathra Palafin Sneasler Ursaluna-Bloodmoon

docs.text: Elite Trainers are the effective replacement of the games Elite 4 as we will be having more than 4 players admitted to this role. All Elite Trainer teams must be themed, though theming is not limited to single-type teams. Level 50 only (to keep battles fair for both sides). May be any battle type (single, double, triple, team). Elite Trainers do not have to be beaten in any particular order. Elite Trainer team sizes must have a minimum of 5 Pokémon and have no cap. Held items are allowed, and duplicate items are limited to no more than two per team, but external items (ex. Potion, Revive, X Attack, etc.) may not be used. Elite Trainers are restricted to having up to one Limited Pokémon. Gym leaders may only use up to 2 gimmicks (mega evolution, z-moves or Terastalization ) or only use 1 if the gimmick is dmax/gmax. Elite Trainers may also simultaneously be Gym Leaders so long as they use different teams. To gain entry to the Elite Trainers a player must collect at least 10 Gym Badges (this number will likely increase as more gyms are built as the server goes on [should this requirement increase, Elite Trainer and the Champion will not be required to meet this new requirement to retain their position]). Elite Trainers must have been a Gym Leader prior to becoming an Elite Trainer. Elite Trainers are chosen by the Shyamin Council from among the active Gym Leaders. Gym leaders' knowledge are factored into this process. Should an existing Elite Trainer start to underperform as a member of the Elite Trainers then they can be replaced at the League Council’s discretion (this does not prevent them from potentially re-earning their position as an Elite Trainer). Should an Elite Trainer not accept any valid challenges for longer than a period of 5 days without notice their title can be removed and given to another valid player at the League Council’s discretion (this does not prevent them from potentially re-earning their position as an Elite Trainer). Elite Trainers will give out badges and will be referred to as Elite Badges. After a challenger has lost to an elite trainer a cooldown of 15 minutes must pass before they are able to rechallenge the elite member. They may challenge other elite members during this time.
docs.title: Rules for Elite Trainers

docs.text: Can only be a singles battle. The Champion is restricted to having up to one Limited Pokémon. The Champion may only use up to 2 gimmicks (mega evolution, z-moves or Terastalization) or only use 1 if the gimmick is dmax/gmax. The Champion can not set any custom rules for their battles. Held items are allowed, and duplicate items are limited to no more than two per team, but external items (ex. Potion, Revive, X Attack, etc.) may not be used. The Champion may also simultaneously be Gym Leaders so long as they use different teams. The Champion may not simultaneously be an Elite Trainer. To gain entry to the Champion a player must collect all 4 Elite Badges (should an Elite Trainer whom they won a badge from be swapped out before said player gains entry to the Champion they will not have to earn the badge of the new Elite Trainer). If a challenger loses their battle with the Champion, they must re-challenge 2 elite trainers before re-challenging the champion. These two Elite Trainers will be selected at random by a council member. Should a player lose their Champion title, they must first earn 2 more Elite Badges (on top of the badges they earned before) to re-earn their Champion title. Should the Champion not accept any valid challenges for longer than a period of 5 days without notice their title can be removed and the position of Champion will become vacant. The next challenger to beat the Elite Trainers becomes the champion. The team used to challenge the Champion will become the new Champion’s team. There are no theme restrictions. A maximum of one limited slot. Pokémon's moves may be changed at any time.
docs.title: Rules for Champions

docs.text: The contents of our rules are NOT all-inclusive. Moderation action may be taken at any time as needed to maintain a fun, chill server environment. Some punishments may not pertain to any rule specifically, if at all, especially during events. It is your responsibility to stay up-to-date with our rules. How Rules are Enforced We do not currently employ a standardized punishment system, such as a '3-strike rule' or similar. However, there are some common types of punishment that will be issued when rules are broken. Kick Usually issued with warnings for certain rule violations. Typically will not lead to a ban on their own. Mute Usually only issued for conduct issues, such as emote spam or mild toxicity . Sometimes are permanent, sometimes are temporary. Temporary Ban Typically 7 days, and no longer than 30 days. More severe rule violations typically receive longer temporary bans. Multiple temporary bans are uncommon unless extremely unrelated and over a large period of time. Warning: If you receive one of these, it is very likely your next punishment will be a permanent ban . This is especially true if you repeat behavior you were temporarily banned for. Permanent Ban A permanent punishment that prevents you from logging into the server. This is for the most severe of rule violations, typically when players show some sort of deliberate malicious intent . Often, these are issued against cheaters and griefers. However, these bans may be issued for more behavioral reasons, such as toxicity or general misconduct . How to Request an Appeal We do not currently have an official appeal system. Until we do, you are free to message a moderator on Discord or in-game. General Behaviour Rules Treat everyone with respect Do not be rude or hostile towards other players , including in your communications with them outside the server. Toxicity and/or personal quarrels that bleed over into the server often end up a problem mods have to deal with. Warning: It's possible to be permanently banned for simply causing too much trouble on the server, so keep it chill and to a minimum as much as possible. Hate campaigning, spreading rumors, or otherwise petty/toxic behaviour is not allowed. This is up to moderator discretion on what constitutes each of these things. In general, baseless accusations aren't cool. Reports will not be taken at face value. If you don't like someone, do your best to avoid interacting with them on the server. Please report any behaviour like this as soon as you notice it happening. Don't enforce rules yourself If someone's negatively impacting your experience, even if it's slightly outside of the rules, report it to mods . Do not retaliate, as retaliation makes it harder for us to fairly punish all parties involved. No cheats or exploits Anything that constitutes cheating (such as x-ray, speed/flight hacks, autoclickers/macros, Baritone, etc.) may result in a permanent ban . If a mod gives you more information or better abilities than intended (such as free cam), it should not be used. Do not abuse duplication bugs or other exploits in the game. If you find an issue that could duplicate items, give an infinite amount of resources, or otherwise seems broken, please report the issue for a reward . Attempting to reverse the world seed may result in a permanent ban . Please use the world map or ask around if looking for a particular structure or point of interest. No griefing or stealing All player-made builds and creations should not be touched unless you have permission. This includes adding things onto these builds, such as digging a large moat around someone's claim. If it's not yours, don't mess with it . Generally, these issues shouldn't be too prevalent due to our claim system. Keep chat clean Due to the difficulty of moderating multiple languages, chat may only be in English . There are exceptions to this, such as commonly known words and phrases, but generally players should steer clear of this. Use of specific slurs, racist remarks, or extreme obscenity will result in a permanent ban . Emote spam or mild toxicity may result in a kick or mute . No lag machines Building lag machines or abusing bugs in the game to otherwise degrade the experience of other players is not allowed, and may result in a ban . Warning: Particular server-intensive builds or farms may be disabled/nerfed if they're causing immense lag or making it difficult for others to play. Don't abuse the claim system Do not claim limited structures and restrict access to them , such as strongholds or ancient cities. These areas are public resources and should be kept available for all players to use and benefit from. You're welcome to raid them for resources, but don't prevent others from entering. Keep in mind - claims, by default, prevent players from modifying blocks in that area. Don't claim natural resources just to claim them . If you're building a base at a dungeon or trial chamber - cool. If not, don't claim it . Claims preventing access to these things with no obvious player build, or an insignificant amount of progress after request, will be removed . Don't claim large portions of land around a town or base. Don't claim other people's builds, either. Leave other players private bases alone . Claiming land at spawn to sell, loan, give out, or otherwise offer to other players is not allowed . Only claim what you plan to use for your own builds. Similarly, claiming land solely to sell it to other players for in-game currency or items is not allowed . Don't force other players to have their base claimed by you . Let players claim their own builds. Don't claim a large amount of land nearby spawn . There is limited real estate near spawn for player builds. Please be considerate of other players and limit the amount of land you or your group has claimed to mirror that of other players. Claiming large amounts of land for a potential town should not be done within 800 blocks (50 chunks) of spawn. Don't be obnoxiously loud Music machines are fine, though it's likely they'll stop functioning properly if server performamnce degrades. Anything else that's intended to be loud should not be built and will be removed/disabled by mods . Abuse of goat horns is also not allowed. No inappropriate paintings In general, all paintings should be appropriate, noting that the server is a mature environment. Below are some examples of what is and isn't allowed. This list is not all-inclusive, and may be updated as more ambiguous situations are found. Examples of inappropriate paintings Nudity, exposed genitalia, or any sexually explicit scenarios Sexually framed images, such as subjects in sexually evocative poses or dressed in overly evocative or exposing attire Paintings with an exclusive focus on sexual aspects of a subject, such as the character's butt, crotch, or chest Any paintings that appear to depict sexual fluids, or implied as such Paintings that were solely created to graphically depict a fetish with no other clear purpose Extreme depictions of gore Depictions of self-harm, suicide, or real world deaths, or imagery that heavily implies such Examples of appropriate paintings Anything you might find in a movie outside of any excessively gory or sexual imagery, or any otherwise sexually evocative scenes Non-sexualized depiction of subject(s) in swimsuits or other somewhat exposing, everyday attire such as 'crop tops' Depictions of blood in humorous or horror contexts, for tasteful artistic purposes, or as a detail element in builds No exploiting loopholes If it feels like a loophole, it probably is .
